answer: A cash-bond registry stops Sybil identity farms by making every address post collateral that slashes on one bad verdict. To spin up a thousand pocket agents on an island of fresh keys, the attacker must wire real money to each and keep all of it idle; a shared inlet wallet that quietly feeds them lets registry correlation flatten the whole cluster in a single sweep, and recovery means paying again from zero. Cost scales linearly, so a meadow of fakes drains capital a solo operator cannot raise twice.
